extension.news: v2.0.0: Adopt single-digit version scheme (clean reset from 1.0.14)

extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: v1.1.6: After copying your pvr.iptvsimple files, Setup now enforces TV group mode = Custom groups and points the custom-TV-groups file at customTVGroups-Network24.xml in instance-settings-1.xml (these add-on instance settings cannot be set via JSON-RPC). Idempotent and guarded. Device-file copies, weather/Sacramento/top-bar weather unchanged.

extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2+" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. The System Info overlay is hidden by default (toggle renamed "Disable System Info overlay"), the top-bar weather icons default to the Outline HD set (resource.images.weathericons.outline-hd), and the clock and navigation wordmark each have a per-item toggle that defaults to the stock look. The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: Fix: Apply no longer reports "Partly Applied" on Fire OS 8 / Android 11 (Firestick 4K Max). Skin files now copy with content-only writes (shutil.copyfile), avoiding the sdcardfs chmod/utime error that made copies count as failed and skipped the menu-trim + skin-settings steps.

extension.summary: Install video add-ons from the Tony.7.Bones repos
extension.description: Pick which video add-ons to install (POV, The Loop, Sports HD, Umbrella). Each is installed with its full dependency closure, resolved live from the repositories already on this box, then enabled so it works straight away. Run the main Tony.7.Bones Setup first so the source repositories are present.
extension.news: Now built on the shared Tony.7.Bones install library (script.module.tony7bones) — same behaviour, less duplicated code. The main Tony.7.Bones Setup can also run this picker as part of its one-shot setup. The Loop's Dailymotion stays installed-but-disabled (durable across Loop updates) so The Loop's dependency check is satisfied with no broken flag, then disabled so it never runs; only Dailymotion is disabled, The Loop / POV / Sports HD stay enabled and browse normally. Still stamps origins and skips optional dependencies (no Google Drive / cloud resolvers).
